device.description: 24-bit 2-channel delta-sigma ADC with START pin and 2-wire serial interface (DRDY/DOUT, SCLK), 100/16 SPS
device.note: ads1225.pdf (SBAS346C, ADS1225/ADS1226) p.3-4 electrical characteristics (data rate 100/16 SPS, DVDD 2.7-5.5 V, logic levels), p.5 (ADS1225) / p.6 (ADS1226) pin configuration and descriptions, p.13 DRDY/DOUT, MODE (Table 2), START (Table 3), p.14 continuous conversion with START high, data format (Table 4), p.15 data retrieval timing (Table 5: tPD = 50 ns)

registers.name: MUX
registers.note: internal: MUX pin level (Table 1, p.10); 0 = AINP1/AINN1, 1 = AINP2/AINN2

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the MODE / TEMPEN / BUFEN pin levels (pins.levels); MODE 0 = High-Resolution 16 SPS, 1 = High-Speed 100 SPS (Table 2, p.13); no serial registers

pages: p.3-4 (EC), p.5-6 (pins), p.13-15 (DRDY/DOUT, MODE, START, data format, retrieval timing)
notModeled: analog inputs, buffer (BUFEN level stored only), temperature sensor (TEMPEN level stored only), reference
conversion time is the maximum tCONV (Tables 3 and 5): 83.3 ms High-Resolution (MODE = 0), 13.3 ms High-Speed (MODE = 1); typical 1 / 16 SPS and 1 / 100 SPS
START: high = continuous conversions, a pulse (>= 17 us) = one conversion then automatic shutdown, low = shutdown; modeled by pins.start
settling after a MUX, BUFEN, TEMPEN or MODE change; the model just continues converting
DRDY/DOUT stays at the last data bit until the next update unless an extra SCLK forces it high; modeled as idle 1 after the data bits
self-calibration started by 26 SCLKs (START must stay high)
data-update window (no readback) and data overwritten if not read before the next update
variants: ADS1225 (1 channel; pins 5/8/9 GND/NC/NC) and ADS1226 (2 channels; MUX, AINP2, AINN2) share ads1225.pdf; each has its own spec file
